scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved from the cited complete model classification, the classical Deuring--Shafarevich formula and explicit Cartier computations. No independent classification or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd-characteristic wild boundary orders only; classification of source normal forms is assumed. No Newton polygon, a-number, or characteristic-two conclusion.
title: The ordinary-or-zero \(p\)-rank dichotomy for wild boundary cyclic curves
